end.summary:
Read and plotted ordered pairs, including points on axes and reflections.
Identified quadrants from coordinate signs and placed points on the axes.
Answered 5 of 6 ordered-pair attempts without help; quadrant and axis/reflection items were correct without help.
Initially treated (3, 2) and (2, 3) as the same point; this was corrected later by focusing on x first and y second.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised reading ordered pairs, identifying quadrants, placing points on axes, and reflecting points. Harsh used the sign of each coordinate to find quadrants and correctly corrected the mix-up between (3, 2) and (2, 3) later by returning to “x first, y second.” At home, ask them to plot three ordered pairs and explain each move aloud, including one negative coordinate.
